purpose: Test whether ordinary fresh /wc workers can independently perform the parent/Guide synthesis that would otherwise be done manually in ChatGPT.
prerequisite_rule: Arm analyst replicas only after every prerequisite has a terminal durable RETURN/receipt (SUCCESS/VERIFIED/DONE/PARTIAL/BOUNDARY all allowed if truthful) and the six local-batch jobs expose START/RESULT or explicit invalid/boundary evidence.

replicas.independence: fresh worker identity; must not reuse any source worker identity
fresh worker identity; must not reuse any source worker identity

shared_mission: Read only the exact prerequisite returns, local-batch START/RESULT artifacts, compiled telemetry report, current worker contracts and analyst template. Fill the template completely, independently derive bottleneck/next experiment/product status/human action/justified launch count, and draft the next human-facing answer. Do not read the other analyst result before your own result is durable.
comparison_rule: If A and B materially disagree on evidence quality, bottleneck, next experiment, human action, or recommended_wc_launches, require one fresh reconciler job that cites both results and source refs. If they agree materially, no reconciler is required.
success_conditions: Two independent analyst outputs pass the template harness.
Each answer distinguishes evidence from inference and self-reported timing from external telemetry.
Each supplies one canonical /wc prompt or null and a justified integer launch count.
Each draft_reply_to_human says what happened, what the human does now, and where to look.
No analyst promotes strategy, Current, Human Accepted or Served.
human_boundary: External creation of fresh ChatGPT /wc chats remains human-triggered. The system may arm jobs and tell the human exactly how many identical launches are justified; it must not claim unattended chat wake.
